_readme: Single source of truth for KittyNews. The logo, the guidelines sheet, every
infographic and the email shell all render from this file. Change a value here
and re-run the render commands in brand/README.md — nothing is hardcoded.
Colour values are DERIVED, not eyeballed. See _provenance for how, and re-run
the validator before changing any of them.

meta.name: KittyNews
voice: Editorial first, playful second. A real news brand that happens to have a cat.
Short declarative sentences. Lead with the finding, not the setup.
Never cutesy in the copy — the mark carries the personality so the words don't have to.
Every number is attributed. No claim without a source.

_roles.ink: Body text, wordmark. Warm near-black — never #000, which inverts harshly.
_roles.paper: Email background. Warm cream, not #FFFFFF, so dark-mode inversion is graceful.
_roles.sand: Infographic card grounds and pull-quote backgrounds.
_roles.muted: Captions, source lines, footer. 5.76:1 on paper — safe for body text.
_roles.rule: Hairlines and table borders only. Never text.
_roles.marmalade: IDENTITY ONLY — the cat mark, chart slot 1, rules, borders. NOT for text: 2.91:1 on paper fails WCAG.
_roles.marmalade_deep: The text-safe accent. Links, display numerals, accent headings. 5.63:1 on paper.
_roles.teal: Chart slot 2 and accent fills. Large text only (3.75:1).

_rules: Assign slots in fixed order, never cycled. A 6th series folds into 'Other'.
Slot 1 (marmalade) sits at 2.55:1 on sand — below 3:1 — so direct value labels are mandatory on every chart, not optional. That is the required relief channel.
Single-series charts need no legend; the title names the series.
Never a dual-axis chart. Two measures of different scale means two charts.

type._note: Split by medium. PNGs are rasterised in real Chromium so any webfont is safe. Email HTML cannot rely on webfonts, so it uses web-safe stacks chosen to sit close to the PNG typography.

chart_ramp: Derived by brute-force search over brand-adjacent hue families, scored by the
dataviz skill's validate_palette.js (six checks) against the sand surface.
107,520 orderings tested; teal pinned to slot 2 for brand coherence.
Result: lightness band PASS, chroma floor PASS, CVD separation PASS
(worst adjacent dE 9.6 protan, target >=8), normal-vision floor PASS (20.1,
target >=15), contrast RELIEF (marmalade 2.55:1 -> direct labels required).
text_colors: WCAG contrast measured on both paper and sand. marmalade #E8743B scored 2.91
on paper — fails even the 3:1 large-text bar — so it is barred from text and
marmalade_deep #A8481A (5.63:1) carries every accent text role instead.
dark_mode: Infographics ship as PNGs. Gmail and Outlook invert HTML backgrounds but do
NOT invert images, so the ramp only ever meets the sand surface baked into the
PNG and is validated in light mode alone. Dark-mode robustness is handled in
the email chrome: warm near-neutrals (paper/ink) instead of pure #FFF/#000.
